body: Root cause: softmax_inplace converted all non-max probabilities to 0 in float32 before entropy calculation. Fix: token_entropy_from_logits() computes H=log(Z)-E[x] in double from raw logits (log-sum-exp trick). Base GPT-2 small H_mean=8.43 nats, H_max=8.62 nats over 64 tokens. gpt2-alpine-c rebuild clean. Commit pending.
title: fix(gpt2.c): entropy log-sum-exp — base model H=8.43 nats (was 0.0 due to float32 underflow)
